hero.title: Understanding the
hero.description: The competitive entrance exam required by public Studienkollegs. Your performance determines admission — prepare strategically to secure your place.

overview.title: What is the Aufnahmeprüfung?
overview.description: The entrance exam that determines your admission to a public Studienkolleg.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Assesses whether you have the language skills and foundational knowledge to succeed in the demanding Studienkolleg curriculum.

format.title: Format
format.description: Two parts: a German language test (60-90 min) and a subject-specific test (45-60 min) based on your chosen course track.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
competitiveness.description: Limited seats available. Applicants are ranked by score — the higher you score, the better your chances of admission.

components.title: Exam Components
components.description: The exam tests both your German proficiency and subject knowledge.

items.title: C-Test / Lückentest
items.description: Gap-fill exercises testing grammar, vocabulary and reading comprehension

items.title: Written Expression
items.description: Writing summaries, short texts, or discussions

subjectTest.title: Subject-Specific Test
subjectTest.description: Only required for T, M and W courses. G and S courses take an extended German test instead:

courseDetails.title: Course-Specific Details
courseDetails.description: Select your course to see exactly what's tested in the entrance exam.

timeline.title: Exam Timeline
timeline.description: Entrance exams are held twice a year, before each semester begins.
timeline.disclaimer: Exact dates vary significantly by institution. Always verify with your target Studienkolleg.

tips.title: Preparation Tips
tips.description: Maximize your chances with strategic preparation.

items.title: Start Early
items.description: Begin preparation 3-6 months before the exam date

items.title: Reach B2 Level
items.description: Aim for B2 German proficiency minimum

items.title: Practice C-Tests
items.description: Use "Mut zur Lücke" books for targeted practice

items.title: Review Math Basics
items.description: Focus on fundamentals required for your course

items.title: Use Sample Exams
items.description: Practice with papers from Studienkolleg websites

items.title: Analyze Mistakes
items.description: Learn from errors to identify weak areas

items.title: Immerse Yourself
items.description: Listen to German podcasts and media daily

items.title: Check Requirements
items.description: Verify specifics for your target institution

retakes.label: Retakes allowed:
retakes.text: You can typically repeat the exam 1-2 times if you don't pass initially.

private.label: Private Studienkollegs:
private.text: May admit students without an entrance exam, but charge tuition fees.

variations.label: Institution variations:
variations.text: Each Studienkolleg may have slightly different exam formats and requirements.

samples.label: Sample exams available:
samples.text: Many Studienkollegs provide practice exams on their websites.

cta.title: Ready to Prepare?
cta.description: Start your exam preparation today with our structured German language course.
